args.question: What is the cardholder statement on this transaction?

args.narrative: The EUR 54.50 order of 2026-02-09 is receipted and was delivered by USPS on 2026-02-13.

args.explanation: Mastercard 4863 chargeback for EUR 54.50; cardholder said they did not make the purchase. The merchant had the receipt and a USPS delivery proof dated 2026-02-13, the kinds the reason code requires. I represented with both; the issuer accepted on 2026-03-31 and the chargeback was reversed. In USD the debit was 59.47 and the reversal 57.14, so the net cost is the USD 15 chargeback fee plus USD 2.33 of FX difference.
